newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bangchak tenders to buy 1,500/T MTBE for May.
newsitem.headline: Bangchak tenders to buy 1,500/T MTBE for May.

text.p: Bangchak Petroleum Plc issued on Wednesday a tender to buy 1,500-tonne of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) for delivery in May, a company source said.
The tender for the gasoline octane-booster, closes April 10 and is valid for a day.
It its last tender, Bangchak bought an April 16-30 delivery cargo of 1,500 tonnes at $270-$275 per tonne, cost-and-freight Thailand, from Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC).
